name: v5_x_only_rectangles_stage1
description: Stage-1 coarse X-only bandwidth grid for newly added rectangular CFP/ROI partitions with patient-level grouped CV.
notes: This stage searches only newly added rectangular S values; square S values are already covered by v4_x_only_patient_grouped.
R is limited to 1, 2, and 3 for rectangular partitions.
The signal bandwidth grid is coarse but extends beyond 2.0 because v4 selected h=2.0 for the best CFP square candidate.
Top candidates from this run should be merged with v4 results, then only the top 3-5 per image should receive local h refinement.
